paper.title: Antibody CDR maturation via region-local MCMC

generators.name: CDR ESM-2 mutation
generators.description: Propose amino-acid substitutions within the active CDR region using ESM-2 masked sampling while framework positions remain fixed.

evidence.quote: Refine complementarity-determining regions for naturalness and interface quality while masking framework regions.

constraints.name: AbLang naturalness
constraints.description: Score antibody sequence naturalness with AbLang perplexity on the VHH binder.

evidence.quote: Sai fusion target: ablang-score + structure prediction per MCMC step.

constraints.name: ESMFold interface quality
constraints.description: Require predicted binder-antigen interface confidence above threshold.

constraints.name: CDR complexity
constraints.description: Penalize low-complexity or repetitive regions in the matured CDRs.

constraints.name: gap distribution
constraints.description: Keep CDR edits aligned to the seed framework via MAFFT gap Gini against the starting sequence.

optimizers.name: region-local MCMC refinement
optimizers.description: Optimize one CDR region per pass with ESM-2 proposals and AbLang/structure scoring.

evidence.quote: Topology: iterative_refinement with CDR-only masking (NUM1 pattern).

steps.operation: Select active CDR region for this region pass
ESM-2 masked mutation within active CDR
Score AbLang naturalness, ESMFold ipTM, complexity, and gap Gini
MCMC accept/reject on weighted constraint scores

assumptions: 121-aa anti-GFP nanobody VHH seed substitutes full-length scFv benchmarks.
Short peptide antigen stub proxies a folded epitope for smoke-tier ESMFold ipTM.
AbLang scores the VHH as heavy-only; framework positions are fixed via ESM-2 masking.
Region-local solver runs one MCMC pass per CDR (3 passes full tier, 1 pass smoke).
unknowns: Target antigen structure and experimental binding affinity are not modeled.
PyRosetta interface metrics and multi-chain scFv AbLang pairing are out of scope for v1.
CDR IMGT boundaries are approximate on the compact nanobody seed.
